basic_details.job_title: SBC Exports Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 3 Scientific Assistant, Technician Posts
basic_details.short_information: M/s. content_sections.heading: SBC Exports Recruitment 2026 at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: M/s. SBC Exports Ltd. (outsourcing agency supplying manpower to HBCH&RC, Muzaffarpur)
Biomedical B. Tech or Diploma with experience (Scientific Assistant); Degree/Diploma in Medical Electronics/Bio-medical (Technician)
Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre, Muzaffarpur (Bihar)
Walk-in interview; email for online interview (outstation candidates)
10.11.2026 up to 3:00 p.m. (email requesting online interview, for receipt)

content_sections.heading: About the Employer
content_sections.text: M/s. SBC Exports Ltd. describes itself in the notice as an outsourcing agency for the supply of manpower services to HBCH&RC, Muzaffarpur, on contract basis. The posts are for deployment at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre, Shri Krishna Medical College and Hospital Campus, Umanagar, Muzaffarpur (Bihar). The notice is signed by the Supervisor of M/s. SBC Exports Ltd.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates may attend the walk-in interview at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre, Shri Krishna Medical College and Hospital Campus, Umanagar, Muzaffarpur (Bihar) – 842004, on 12 November 2026 between 09.00 am and 10.00 am. Outstation candidates may attend the interview online. They must email their Resume with the supporting documents to [email protected] . Write the post applied for in the subject line of the email (Scientific Assistant (Biomedical) or Technician (Biomedical)). Attach the Resume, Educational Certificates, Experience Certificates and a copy of Aadhar and PAN Card in a single PDF file. Make sure the email is received by 10.11.2026 up to 3:00 p.m. Only shortlisted candidates who fulfil the norms will be contacted for the online interview.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Essential: B. Tech in Biomedical Engineering with 01 year of experience in a hospital setup. OR Diploma (Biomedical / Medical Electronics) with 3 years' experience out of which 1 year in hospital setup. Desirable: a candidate desirous to work independently for in-house repairs/maintenance/calibration activity shall be preferred. Age limit: 27 Years, as on the Walk-In Interview date. A deserving and bright candidate may be given relaxation in age. Full Time Degree/Diploma in Medical Electronics/Bio-medical from the State Board of Technical Examination (10+3), years' course. Experience: 0-2 year of experience in hospital in maintenance/services of hospital essential. Age limit: 30 Years, as on the Walk-In Interview date. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.pay: Rs. 20,644/- (Rupees Twenty Thousand Six Hundred Forty Four only)

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Candidates must carry the following to the walk-in interview, with the certificates in original and one set of self-attested copies: Bio-data Recent passport size photograph PAN Card Aadhar Card Educational and Experience Certificates

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notice names an interview, held as a walk-in on 12 November 2026 or online for outstation candidates. For the online interview, only shortlisted candidates who fulfil the norms will be contacted. The notice does not describe any other stage.

rows.event: Last date for receiving email requesting online interview

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The appointment is initially for a period of six months and extendable, if required. Accommodation will not be provided to outstation candidates. Outstation candidates who want an online interview must send the email by the deadline above; only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. The posts are on contract basis through M/s. SBC Exports Ltd., an outsourcing agency.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in the SBC Exports recruitment?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 2 for Scientific Assistant (Biomedical) and 1 for Technician (Biomedical).

faq.question: Q2. When is the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 12 November 2026 between 09.00 am and 10.00 am at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Research Centre, Umanagar, Muzaffarpur (Bihar) – 842004.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to email for an online interview?
faq.answer: The email must be received by 10 November 2026 up to 3:00 p.m., for both posts.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Scientific Assistant (Biomedical)?
faq.answer: B. Tech in Biomedical Engineering with 01 year of experience in a hospital setup, OR Diploma (Biomedical / Medical Electronics) with 3 years' experience out of which 1 year in hospital setup.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for Technician (Biomedical)?
faq.answer: A Full Time Degree/Diploma in Medical Electronics/Bio-medical from the State Board of Technical Examination (10+3), years' course, with 0-2 year of hospital maintenance/services experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The limit is 27 Years for Scientific Assistant (Biomedical) and 30 Years for Technician (Biomedical), as on the Walk-In Interview date. A deserving and bright candidate may be given age relaxation for Scientific Assistant.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The monthly remuneration is Rs. 30,000/- for Scientific Assistant (Biomedical) and Rs. 20,644/- for Technician (Biomedical).

faq.question: Q8. Can outstation candidates attend the interview online?
faq.answer: Yes. They must email the Resume and documents in a single PDF to [email protected], with the post name in the subject line. Accommodation is not provided.

faq.question: Q9. Is the job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is on contract basis through M/s. SBC Exports Ltd., initially for six months and extendable, if required.
